Definition: of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power:--loin.
BiblicalUsage: The loins are where strength is gathered. John the Baptist wore a leathern girdle about his loins in the wilderness, and Paul tells believers to stand with their loins girt about with truth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe loins girt about with truth is the picture of a soldier ready: John wore his leather girdle in the wilderness, and Paul tells me to wear the truth the same way.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
